episodes.title: Inside Zimbabwe's Dangerous Cult: The Story of Mai Maria | Documentary⁠
episodes.description:
Zimbabwe’s Divine Cult | Inside the Mudzimu Unoera Sect | Mai Maria & Tepsy Nyanhete

What really happened inside the Mudzimu Unoera cult in Guruve, Zimbabwe?

In this true crime documentary, we examine the disturbing allegations surrounding the Mudzimu Unoera sect, led by Enia “Mai Maria” Nyanhete and her daughter, News Tepsy Nyanhete. Using investigative approach, this documentary explores who was involved, what allegedly happened inside the secluded compound, where it took place, why authorities intervened, and how the case became one of Zimbabwe’s most shocking alleged cult investigations.

The video also compares this case with other high-profile cult cases, including those involving Madzibaba Ishmael Chokurongerwa in Zimbabwe, Paul Mackenzie and the Shakahola Forest tragedy in Kenya, and NXIVM in the United States, highlighting the warning signs of coercive control and religious extremism.

Disclaimer: This video is based on publicly reported information, court proceedings, and news reports available at the time of publication. All individuals mentioned are presumed innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law. The purpose of this documentary is to inform, educate, and raise awareness about alleged criminal cases of public interest.

episodes.title: Inside Zimbabwe's Most Notorious Cult: Robert Gumbura⁠
episodes.description:
He preached salvation… but behind closed doors, a nightmare unfolded.

Robert Martin Gumbura built one of Zimbabwe’s most controversial religious empires, presenting himself as a wealthy, God-appointed leader while secretly abusing his power for years.

This documentary uncovers the shocking rise and fall of the man known as “The Wolf of Marlborough.” From his luxurious lifestyle, multiple wives, and growing church empire to the dramatic police raid, emotional courtroom testimony, conviction, imprisonment at Chikurubi Maximum Prison, and his final days behind bars, this is one of Zimbabwe’s most disturbing true crime stories.

⚠️ Viewer discretion is advised. This documentary discusses sexual abuse, manipulation, and psychological control.
